title: Crime Reports | Atlanta Police Department
key_finding: APD's official Crime Reports page links the 2024 Year End Crime Report under the department's crime-statistics downloads.

title: 2024 Year End Crime Report
key_finding: The official APD year-end PDF publishes exact 2024 citywide counts of homicide 126, rape 79, robbery 506, aggravated assault 2444, burglary/breaking and entering 1704, theft from motor vehicle 7195, shoplifting 2284, all other larceny 3729, and motor vehicle theft 3673, and it publishes airport separately.

title: APD Zones | Atlanta Police Department
key_finding: APD's official zones page lists Airport plus Zones 1 through 6 as separate APD service and reporting areas.

title: Airport | Atlanta Police Department
key_finding: APD's Airport page says the Airport Section provides police services for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, including terminals, concourses, and parking lots.
